docs.title: Welcome to Iron Jetpacks Wiki
docs.text: This is the official documentation for the Iron Jetpacks mod.

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text: Welcome to the Iron Jetpacks mod! This mod adds a variety of jetpacks to help you navigate your world with ease.

docs.title: Keybindings
docs.text: By default, the jetpack is controlled using specific keys. You can change these in the Minecraft settings under Controls → Key Binds.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
1. Install Fabric Loader.
  2. Place the Iron Jetpacks .jar file in your mods folder.
  3. Launch the game and enjoy!

docs.text: Crafting recipes for all items.

docs.title: Coils
docs.text:
Coils are essential components for cells and thrusters. All coils follow the same crafting pattern: \ R \, \RDR\, \ R \ where \R\ is Redstone and \D\ is the material.

Coil Material (D) Basic Coil Iron Ingot Advanced Coil Gold Ingot Elite Coil Diamond Ultimate Coil Emerald Expert Coil Netherite Ingot

docs.title: Straps
docs.text:
Straps are used to assemble the final jetpack.

Recipe: \ I \, \LLL\, \ I `n- I: Iron Nugget - L: Leather
